reviewer: separate computational AI agent, not a human or forensic specialist
coordinate_convention: zero-based native stored pixels; origin upper-left; x rightward; y downward
uncertainty_definition: Subjective rectangular localization envelope around the stated point, in encoded pixels; not statistical confidence, physical accuracy, or a calibrated measurement error.
independence_limits: Prior case knowledge and prior Camera 2/4 visual screening acknowledged. These frames have been seen in prior overview/native reviews. Seeds selected before scoring; no current algorithm results viewed. Not a pristine holdout or independent human annotation.
anchor_definition: Coordinates describe the fixed patch-center anchor located by the named local feature, not a claim that each seed is the exact mathematical corner or a surveyed material point. Equal rounded coordinates mean no shift resolved at the stated visual envelope, not zero camera motion.
